scope: Actual IRISGraphStore readers and engine.khop on IRIS 2026.1 (pin 3eaa79cf), Arno library absent. Expected answers are the port of traversal_strategy.rs applied to the edge history this binding wrote. The SQL fallback is forced by replacing _select_bfs_strategy on this store instance with the product's own _SqlBfsFallbackAdapter; Arno selection is observed only through _select_bfs_strategy with _detect_arno / _arno_capabilities / _only_default_graph injected on the instance (the Arno walk itself is not run). Cypher callers are not exercised.
